info.name: Weld REST Connection Bridge ELT Stream Runs API

params.name: id
params.description: The opaque ID of the ELT Stream Run.

items.docs: Get details of a specific ELT Stream Run by its unique identifier.

params.name: elt_stream_id
params.description: The ID of the ELT Stream to list runs for.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: The cursor to use in pagination. Use the value of the `next_cursor` field from the response of a previous list request.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of items to return in a single page.

params.name: sort_direction
params.description: The direction to sort the results.

items.docs: List runs for a specific ELT Stream in pages sorted by their start date. Only runs from the last 3 months are available.
